tools.name: fetch_url
tools.description: Fetch a URL over HTTP(S) and return the response body as text. Follows redirects by default and decodes the charset from the Content-Type header. Use this for reading documentation pages or APIs; use fetch_binary when the body is binary.

url.description: Absolute http:// or https:// URL to fetch.

headers.description: Extra request headers as a flat string map, e.g. {"Accept-Language": "zh-CN"}.

timeout_ms.description: Abort the request after this many milliseconds.

tools.name: fetch_binary
tools.description: Fetch a URL and return the raw body as base64 so binary content survives intact. Use this instead of fetch_url for images, PDFs, and archives. Returns `{ encoding, size, content }`.

max_bytes.description: Abort if the body exceeds this many bytes.

tools.name: clear_http_cache
tools.description: Delete every cached response entry for the current session, so the next lookup revalidates with its origin instead of serving stale data. Destructive to cache state but never touches user data. Returns the number of entries evicted.

scope.description: How much of the cache to clear. `host` clears one host; `all` clears every host.
